newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW-Beckman CEO backs fy96 EPS views.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Beckman CEO backs fy96 EPS views.

text.p: The chairman and chief executive of Beckman Instruments Inc said on Wednesday the supplier of equipment and services to the health care industry can reach $2.58 in per share earnings in the fiscal year ending December 1996.

Asked in an interview whether he is comfortable with Wall Street analysts' consensus estimate of $2.58 per share in net income for this year, the executive Louis Rosso, answered, "Yes, we can hit that."
In an address to the Atlanta Society of Financial Analysts, Rosso said the company's sales are not advancing as rapidly as he would like. "We are not growing fast enough at the top line," he said.

In the interview after he spoke to the analysts, Rosso said the Fullerton, California-based company has a goal of pre-acquisition sales growth of seven to nine percent annually beginning in 1998 or 1999 from this year's estimated sales growth of five percent.
